paragraph: UNHCR counted [8,921 registered Kasai refugees in 2,101 households in April 2026](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/122083>). They came to Angola in 2017, and UNHCR says every registered refugee family receives identity documents. The same report says [the government has suspended registration of new arrivals since October 2017](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/122083>). In late 2024 [UNHCR and the migration service held their first joint registration missions in the southern provinces, registering 7,200 refugees](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/ed47ffb8-b4bc-482f-8115-1a0e08de0a19/UNHCR%20Regional%20Update%20-%20Southern%20Africa%20Operational%20Update%20%28October%20-%20December%202024%29.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

ONPRA and UNHCR [completed level-2 biometric registration of 54,343 Congolese refugees at the Busuma site in July 2026](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/details/123171>). In the last twelve months, in late July 2026, ONPRA also [began registering and updating the records of about 4,000 refugees at the Cishemere transit centre](<https://burundi-forum.org/115082/le-hcr-et-lonpra-renforcent-lidentification-au-centre-de-transit-de-cishemere/>). For two years to September 2025 the Merankabandi programme [paid selected refugees 73,600 BIF every two months through their mobile phones](<https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/2025/09/22/buhumuza-clap-de-fin-pour-merankabandi-deux-annees-de-transferts-monetaires-qui-ont-transforme-la-vie-des-refugies/>). No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.

UNHCR says [about 30,400 refugees and asylum-seekers were individually registered by 30 June 2026](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/f6250826-c828-52ec-84d0-2c6684a94524/Fact%20Sheet%20-%20UNHCR%20Benin%20-%20January%20-%20June%202026%20-%20FINAL.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, [UNHCR, the refugee commission SP-CNRA and the identification agency ANIP set a roadmap for enrolling refugees biometrically in the national register](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/f6250826-c828-52ec-84d0-2c6684a94524/Fact%20Sheet%20-%20UNHCR%20Benin%20-%20January%20-%20June%202026%20-%20FINAL.pdf>). On 30 October 2026 [ANIP said it planned to enrol about 30,000 refugees in November 2026](<https://lematinal.bj/modernisation-des-services-didentification-au-benin-lanip-accelere-sa-revolution-numerique/>). In August 2026 [Decryptage counted 16,463 recognised refugees without valid ID cards](<https://decryptage.bj/2026/08/24/deplacements-forces-le-benin-accueille-8-400-nouveaux-refugies-en-6-mois/>). No source found says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

ANOTEL applies decree 2023-1721 of 15 December 2023. It says [the refugee identity card and the CONAREF attestation are the only documents accepted for refugees to buy a SIM card](<https://burkina24.com/2024/05/13/communique-de-lassociation-nationale-des-operateurs-telecommunications-anotel/>). The territorial administration ministry [issued more than 121,000 civil-status documents to displaced people in 2025](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article144154>). In the last twelve months, when enrolment for the unique identifier began on 11 November 2026, the minister said [mobile teams would go to displaced people](<https://www.aa.com.tr/fr/afrique/burkina-faso-lancement-de-l-op%C3%A9ration-d-enregistrement-de-masse-de-la-population-au-registre-de-l-identifiant-unique/4120810>). No source found since October 2023 counts refugees or displaced people with a SIM, an account or a digital ID. Mature would need a published number or share of them with a SIM, an account or a digital ID.

In September 2024 Parliament passed [a bill to issue the national identity card, the Omang, to every person granted refugee status](<https://thepatriot.co.bw/hope-for-refugees/>). The Patriot says the bill [gives refugees an Omang so they can register SIM cards](<https://thepatriot.co.bw/hope-for-refugees/>). In the last twelve months, at the World Refugee Day event at Dukwi in June 2026, [Minister Pius Mokgware handed citizenship documents to 64 refugees](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/91946>). No source found says refugees have been issued the Omang under the 2024 bill. Operating would need a source showing refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.

UNHCR says [37,389 Sudanese refugees had been registered in the Central African Republic by June 2026](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/123755>). Registration began in April 2023, with the National Commission for Refugees. In October and November 2024 [UNHCR and the commission registered 1,189 Sudanese refugees biometrically in Rafai](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/17adc394-a6f1-4822-95b3-bbc21074873d/2024_HCR%20CAR_Operational%20Update_October%20and%20November%20-%20EN.pdf>). In the last twelve months, UNHCR's report for April to June 2026 says [737 were registered individually, and 1,958 new arrivals in Manou](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/123755>). No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

In 2024 [29,233 refugees were registered individually with DAARA](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/116174>), the government counterpart. A July 2025 interministerial order [recognised as refugees over 69,000 Burkinabe and about 1,500 Malians registered since May 2021](<https://achpr.au.int/fr/news/communique-de-presse/2025-11-25/communique-de-presse-sur-loctroi-du-statut-de-refugies-pour>), the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights says. In the last twelve months, from April to June 2026, [UNHCR and the government registered 3,619 new arrivals in 684 households in the north](<https://data.unhcr.org/fr/documents/download/123738>). Registered new arrivals receive refugee attestations or other proof of identity. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

UNHCR says [a biometric identification programme had given 25,000 refugees legal identification by March 2025](<https://www.unhcr.org/africa/news/press-releases/unhcr-applauds-cameroons-inclusive-approach-displacement-and-calls-increased>). In April 2024 [IOM and the civil registration office BUNEC handed displaced and vulnerable people 507 rebuilt birth certificates in Bertoua and 683 legal identity documents in Yaoundé](<https://www.iom.int/news/legal-identity-1340-birth-certificates-and-national-identity-cards-internally-displaced-persons-and-vulnerable-populations>). A December 2024 law [lets displaced people have civil-status records issued or rebuilt](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS5A-S1-3-Cameroun_FINAL.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. In October 2024 [UNHCR and partners agreed to install digital kiosks with internet and Mobile Money services at Minawao refugee camp](<https://actucameroun.com/2024/10/24/un-partenariat-pour-linstallation-de-kiosques-numeriques-au-camp-de-refugies-de-minawao/>). No source found says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may, by law or in practice.

UNHCR and the refugee commission CNR say [391,764 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered in proGres at 31 May 2025](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/4f09ed69-a5dc-5410-8399-66c46653c05c/COD_MonthlyRefugeeStatistics_31052025_EN_PBI_Okay.pdf>), each holding at least one protection document. On 20 November 2024 [ONIP and the CNR signed a protocol to identify refugees systematically](<https://b-onetv.cd/protocole-daccord-entre-lonip-et-la-cnr-pour-lidentification-des-refugies-en-rdc/>). In November 2025 [the interior minister told the Senate how ONIP will identify the population](<https://acp.cd/nation/rdc-le-senat-informe-de-la-delivrance-lannee-prochaine-de-la-carte-didentite/>), by strata, starting with Kinshasa. No later change to the count or the protocol has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.

On 6 February 2026 [the foreign affairs and social affairs ministers handed biometric passports to ten refugees in Brazzaville](<https://www.aci.cg/congo-diplomatie-remise-des-passeports-biometriques-aux-refugies/>). The passports are refugee travel documents, and the news agency ACI reported the handover. In the last twelve months this is the one event found. ACI says [the handover will continue progressively, under a government partnership with UNHCR](<https://www.aci.cg/congo-diplomatie-remise-des-passeports-biometriques-aux-refugies/>). No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

UNHCR's southern Africa office publishes a monthly statistical report from its joint registration exercise. On 30 November 2025 it [listed 24 people in Comoros: 17 asylum-seekers and 7 refugees](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/0d7e8995-cff6-5bdb-8af2-ca7661bb6e36/Monthly%20Protection%20Dashboard%20-%2030%20NOV%202025.pdf>). The report counts people registered in each country of asylum and gives no other figure for Comoros. In the last twelve months it is the only count found. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

In March 2024 [the education ministry helped 158 refugee teachers in Ali Addeh and Holl-Holl open accounts at East Africa Bank](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/cdde8002-a416-4ea1-a6f9-05412c05d89c/HCR%20Djibouti_Operational%20Update_Mars%202024%20.pdf>). UNHCR says [registration of new arrivals and status determination were suspended in February 2024](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/2ff83b2a-c4fa-4507-9e9f-140aceb31c36/UNHCR%20Djibouti_Operational%20Update_May%202024_EN.pdf>). On 28 January 2025 [UNHCR and the refugee office ONARS registered 18 people in Djibouti-ville and delivered 122 attestations](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/f2697046-462e-4ea3-9eb0-8ec8fa3015f4/Operational%20updates_06%2002%2025.pdf>). By early March 2025 [they had registered 29 more new arrivals and issued 199 certificates and 14 identity cards](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/01518b42-d753-4211-95f6-39df80609195/Operational%20Update_06%2003%202025.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found counts refugees with a SIM, an account or a digital ID across the country.

UNHCR [finalised 4,056 new and 15,301 continuous registrations of refugees and asylum-seekers up to March 2024](<https://rdppna.interno.gov.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Algeria.pdf>), the RDPP North Africa programme reports. Algeria has no national asylum system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID, or counts those who do. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID, by law or in practice.

UNHCR Egypt says [1,100,600 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered with it as of 30 April 2026](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/122361>). In April 2025 [691,000 Sudanese registered with UNHCR held its yellow card](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202602020025.html>), a temporary substitute for residency, Radio Dabanga reports. In the last twelve months, UN experts put [registered refugees and asylum-seekers at 1,098,311 in December 2025](<https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2026/03/egypt-un-experts-raise-alarm-over-violations-against-refugees-and-migrants>). No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID, or counts those who do. Operating would need a source showing refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.

In 2026 UNHCR's rights mapping platform said [Eritrea has no national legal framework for refugees or asylum seekers](<https://rimap.unhcr.org/countries/eritrea>). The Elite Camp closed in 2012, and the government then withdrew refugee status from refugees living in towns. Their legal status remains unclear. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration of refugees is planned or under way. Preparing would need a source showing that the government or UNHCR planned, began or resumed registering or documenting refugees, or piloted a digital service for them.

The World Bank reports [191,335 refugees had received a Fayda ID by 23 March 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099051826154014658/pdf/P179040-a6dcbb64-0dbc-48cc-9c1d-eecfc41d1d44.pdf>). In the last twelve months that count rose from 120,765 at 30 September 2025. Issue began in March 2024, and [9,669 refugees held Fayda-numbered ID cards by August 2024](<https://reliefweb.int/report/ethiopia/ethiopia-unhcr-operational-update-august-2024>). UNHCR said in 2024 that [the refugee digital IDs let refugees open bank accounts and get mobile connectivity](<https://reliefweb.int/report/ethiopia/ethiopia-unhcr-operational-update-august-2024>). Under the Makatet inclusion framework launched in June 2026, [the ID programme is issuing Fayda to refugees](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202607/fayda-digital-id-critical-for-ethiopias-five-year-refugee-inclusion-strategy>).

The 2026 SIM registration rules [list refugees among those who must register, using the Refugee Non Citizen ID](<https://nca.org.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/SIM-Reg-FAQs-2026.pdf>). By 6 February 2025 [the Ghana Refugee Board and UNHCR had biometrically registered 9,625 displaced Burkinabes](<https://www.unhcr.org/africa/news/press-releases/unhcr-welcomes-ghana-s-granting-prima-facie-refugee-status-displaced-burkinabes>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [registration of refugees for the Ghana Card spread to the Western and Volta regions](<https://fims.org.gh/refugee-registration-exercise-expands-to-western-and-volta-regions/>). It began in Greater Accra in 2023. In August 2026 [the foreign ministry gave the refugee board passport equipment to register refugees and produce their IDs](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/foreign-affairs-hands-over-gh-539-574-worth-equipment-to-ghana-refugee-board.html>). No source found since October 2023 counts refugees or displaced people with a SIM, an account or a digital ID. Mature would need a published number or share of them with a SIM, an account or a digital ID.

In October 2024 [Guinea told UNHCR it counted 2,322 refugees](<https://www.unhcr.org/sites/default/files/2024-10/43-Guinea.pdf>), and that new asylum seekers go through status determination. The executive secretary of the CNISR commission says [it registers asylum seekers with UNHCR](<https://matd.gov.gn/cnisr-discours-du-secretaire-executif-a-latelier-dappropriation/>). Guinea's 2018 asylum law provides biometric refugee ID cards and travel documents, but [no implementing decree has been published, UNHCR says](<https://rimap.unhcr.org/countries/guinea>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says how many refugees were issued documents. Establishing would need refugees registered and issued identity documents, with a number stated.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether refugees or displaced people in the Gambia are registered or can use digital services. An earlier source says The Gambia joined regional initiatives on digital identity for displaced people, and nothing since October 2023 says it plans or runs their registration. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a source showing that the government or UNHCR planned, began or resumed registering or documenting refugees or internally displaced people, or piloted a digital service for them.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether refugees or displaced people in Guinea-Bissau are registered or can use digital services. Every earlier source found dates from 2017 or 2018, outside the three-year range. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that refugees or internally displaced people are not registered, hold no documents, are barred from SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID, or that their registration is suspended.

In 2026 UNHCR's rights mapping platform said [Equatorial Guinea has no domestic framework for refugee status determination](<https://rimap.unhcr.org/countries/equatorial-guinea>). Asylum seekers therefore have no formal procedure to apply for refugee status, and refugees have no established rights or entitlements. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration of refugees is planned or under way. None says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Preparing would need a source showing that registration of refugees was planned, begun or resumed.

On 30 May 2025 the government issued [Legal Notice No. 90](<https://www.gsma.com/solutions-and-impact/connectivity-for-good/mobile-for-development/gsma_resources/connecting-refugees-in-kenya-overcoming-policy-barriers-to-accessing-digital-services/>), GSMA reports. It recognises refugee identity cards for SIM card registration for the first time. In February 2024 the Commissioner of Refugee Affairs put [registered refugees and asylum-seekers at over 650,000](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/news/18991/refugees-given-30-days-to-collect-unclaimed-id-cards>). The 2026 Economic Survey says [registration of new arrivals in Dadaab resumed in May 2023, the first since 2016](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-05-03-kenyas-refugee-population-grows-by-300000-in-five-years>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No count of refugees with a SIM, an account or a digital ID has been found since October 2023. Mature would need a published number or share of them with a registered SIM, an account or a national digital ID.

In February 2025 Executive Order No. 144 [speeds up residence and documents for registered former Ivorian refugees, free of charge](<https://gnnliberia.com/president-boakai-issues-executive-order-no-144-to-enhance-support-for-refugees-and-vulnerable-populations-in-liberia/>). In the last twelve months, on 25 February 2026, [the refugee commission, the immigration service and the National Identification Registry signed an agreement on refugee identity](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/news/gov-t-launches-coordinated-biometric-id-for-refugees/article_5561d8d7-dd72-4f92-95e9-aa0244a59745.html>). The registry is to capture refugees' biometrics. In June 2026 [the commission, now RAMCO, said the agreement would improve legal documentation](<https://lina.micat.gov.lr/lrrrc-rebrands-to-ramco-expands-mandate-to-cover-all-human-mobility/>). No source found says refugees were issued the new cards, with a number stated. Establishing would need refugees registered and issued identity documents, with a number stated.

In the last twelve months UNHCR's report for 2025 says [it had registered 108,455 refugees and asylum-seekers individually in Libya by the end of 2025](<https://www.unhcr.org/us/sites/en-us/files/2026-06/unhcr-annual-results-report-2025-libya_6.pdf>), 40,699 of them new that year. A year earlier [the total was 79,019, registered at UNHCR's Tripoli centre](<https://www.unhcr.org/uk/sites/uk/files/2025-06/Libya%20ARR%202024_65.pdf>). Each refugee registered receives an asylum-seeker or refugee certificate. But [Libyan authorities do not recognise UNHCR's documents, and most Sudanese refugees in the east are undocumented](<https://www.unhcr.org/us/sites/en-us/files/2026-06/unhcr-annual-results-report-2025-libya_6.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may, by law or in practice.

The Lesotho Times reports [a government freeze on refugee identity cards and travel documents](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91350>). It began in July 2025, after corruption allegations against refugee and passport officials. In 2026 the freeze was in its second year, and hundreds of refugees were left without valid documents. In March 2024 the National Assembly committee [allowed SIM rules that let asylum seekers register SIM cards on their asylum-seeker certificate](<https://nationalassembly.parliament.ls/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/communications-Regulations-1.pdf>). In the last twelve months no source found says the freeze has ended. Preparing would need a source showing that the government or UNHCR planned, began or resumed registering or documenting refugees, or piloted a digital service for them.

[By the end of 2024 UNHCR had registered 18,900 people from 64 countries in Morocco](<https://www.unhcr.org/where-we-work/countries/morocco>), including 4,679 new registrations in 2024, mostly of Sudanese people. UNHCR says [Morocco's refugee bureau, which regularises refugees UNHCR has registered, sat twice a week in 2024](<https://rimap.unhcr.org/countries/morocco>). It reviewed about 20 people a week and admitted undocumented refugees and unaccompanied children. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

UNHCR's rights mapping platform says [Madagascar has no operational asylum system](<https://rimap.unhcr.org/countries/madagascar>). The Office for Refugees and Stateless Persons has never worked in practice, and refugees and asylum seekers receive no formal protection or legal status. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration of refugees is planned or under way. None says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Preparing would need a source showing that registration of refugees was planned, begun or resumed.

Early in 2025 [biometric registration was suspended indefinitely after US funding stopped](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/116698>), leaving 64,315 asylum-seekers without formal status. In the last quarter of 2025 [CNCR registered 13,628 refugees biometrically, while 10,345 remained unregistered](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/8389635c-2ea4-592d-961a-7fea66dfd200/Oprational%20Update_UNHCR%20Mali-4%C3%A9%20trimestre%202025%20%282%29.pdf>). In the last twelve months, from April to June 2026, [CNCR and UNHCR registered and enrolled 4,950 people biometrically](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/71934176-0890-4bed-8159-9c9c145773bc/Operational%20Update%20UNHCR_%20Mali_%20Q2-%202026.pdf>) and distributed 17,806 refugee ID cards. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.

In the nine months to October 2024 [the provincial identification service took about 12,478 ID card applications from displaced families](<https://www.zumbofm.com/index.php/noticias/item/6443-cabo-delgado-mais-4-mil-deslocados-recebem-bilhetes-de-identificacao>) in Cabo Delgado. It produced 5,516 cards and delivered 4,764. The National Director of Registries and Notaries says [more than 145,000 displaced people have been registered since the attacks in the north began](<https://www.child-identity.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Arnaldo-ENglish-Reuniao-de-Lanc%C2%B8amento-Regional-do-Quadro-de-Programa-Estrate%C2%B4gico-para-o-Fortalecimento-do-RCEV-ENGL-1-002-en-GB.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [Japan and UNHCR agreed a USD 6.9 million grant for 2026 to 2028](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/news/22845>). It will bring mobile civil documentation to about 100,000 displaced and returnee people in Cabo Delgado. No source found since October 2023 says displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may.

UNHCR counts refugees in the camp with financial products, including bank accounts, and [their number rose from 2,400 in 2022 to 5,600 in 2023](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/f7061047-915e-4e87-a705-a8682c49a725/Mauritania%20Factsheet%20-%20March%202024%20%281%29.pdf>). In February 2024 [it counted 128,000 registered refugees and asylum-seekers](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/f7061047-915e-4e87-a705-a8682c49a725/Mauritania%20Factsheet%20-%20March%202024%20%281%29.pdf>). A World Bank project [is piloting continuous updating of the social registry, open to refugee households](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/sahel-adaptive-social-protection-program-trust-fund/country-work/mauritania>). In the last twelve months, UNHCR's factsheet of January 2026 says [around 185,000 refugees were in the national population registry by December 2025](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/a6553726-0803-553f-8c28-d41f409e0d65/UNHCR%20Mauritania_Hodh%20Chargui%20Factsheet%20-%20January%202026%20%281%29.pdf>).

UNHCR's 2024 results report covers Mauritius from its South Africa office. It says [79 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered individually in Mauritius in 2024](<https://www.unhcr.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/South%20Africa%20MCO%20ARR%202024.pdf>). The registration was done remotely, and protection documents were issued to them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says refugees may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID, or counts those who do. Operating would need a source showing that they may register SIM cards, open mobile money or bank accounts, or enrol in the national digital ID.

UNHCR reports [more than 1,100 asylum-seekers from Mozambique registered in Nsanje District by the end of December 2024](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/ed47ffb8-b4bc-482f-8115-1a0e08de0a19/UNHCR%20Regional%20Update%20-%20Southern%20Africa%20Operational%20Update%20%28October%20-%20December%202024%29.pdf>). In June 2023 the National Registration Bureau's principal secretary said [nine national IDs issued illegally to refugees were confiscated, and that the Registration Act gives no mandate to register refugees](<https://malawi24.com/2023/06/23/nrb-confiscates-national-ids-from-refugees/>). In December 2019 UNHCR reported that [the Bureau had announced plans to register refugees and asylum-seekers and issue them ID cards](<https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/download/74288>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says refugees in Malawi may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Operating would need a source showing that they may, by law or in practice.

[The Home Affairs minister said 682 African guest identity cards were issued to refugees in 2025](<http://www.namibiansun.com/nmh-hub/over-117-000-ids-issued-in-2025-nmh006942-1-7902>), easing refugees' access to education, employment and financial services.
